```python
import re

def text_match_one(text):
    return bool(re.fullmatch(r'ab+', text))
```

I changed this from `re.search` to a full-string match, per the team note. The earlier version would also return True for strings like "xabbx". `re.fullmatch` is used instead of `^ab+$` because `$` also matches before a trailing newline, so "ab\n" would pass with `$`.
